Open Positions

  • Sales Engineer

    This is the first SE hire in North America. You will be the technical voice of QIZ in strategic sales conversations, working directly with security architects, cryptography teams, and CISOs across financial services, critical infrastructure, federal, and large enterprise accounts. You will work alongside an exceptional team and engage with marquee customers from day one. You will own the technical thread in every customer and partner engagement: running discovery, delivering demos and architecture discussions, supporting POCs, and helping design partners shape how QIZ fits into their environments. You will also support channel partner enablement as we scale our partner ecosystem in the US. This role reports to the Head of Sales, North America, and works closely with the product and engineering teams in Israel.

    US, East Coast

  • Product Manager

    We are looking for a Product Manager who combines product strategy with technical fluency. You will define the “What” and “Why” of our platform, partnering with R&D on the “How.” You don’t need to write code, but you must be comfortable diving into technical details to build a product that makes a complex migration feel actionable for CISOs and DevOps teams. As the first PM reporting directly to the VP of Product, this is a unique opportunity to shape the product culture, accelerate your professional growth, and make a tangible, high-visibility impact on a foundational security platform.
